description: Golden set for the Layer B prose eval (PRD docs/sprints/llm-refactor-prd.md §1A). Real, well-built sites across categories — NOT deliberately-broken fixtures. The eval audits each twice (template vs LLM prose) and scores the pair with the judge. Keep this ~10 sites and varied so the win-rate generalizes.

sites.note: polished, JS-heavy — expect thin findings + brand-rich voice
JS-rendered shell — thin brand DNA from HTTP snapshot
minimal server-rendered HTML — strong contrast to the polished sites
opinionated marketing copy — good brand-voice test
deliberately plain/old site — many structural findings, contrast case
